facts.fact: 男主两天没有出门，不想见人，自认大概是在哀悼
facts.anchor: I haven’t been out of the house for two days

facts.fact: 两周前 Arthur 和 Caroline 还只是登记册上的两个名字
facts.anchor: Arthur and Caroline were just names on a register

facts.fact: 这种不成比例的悲伤像侧风一样撕扯着他
facts.anchor: disproportionate grief tore at him like a crosswind

facts.fact: 他哀悼的是自己、自己的人生、破碎的婚姻（后面还有 his kids）
facts.anchor: He was grieving for himself, his life, his broken marriage

facts.fact: 他把给 Arthur 的信原封不动放在壁炉台上
facts.anchor: He’d kept the letter to Arthur unopened on the mantelpiece

facts.fact: 他三天后又读了三本 Caroline 的笔记本
facts.anchor: he’d read another three of her notebooks

facts.fact: Caroline 的日记写：老 Arthur 有时会回来——一小时，或一天
facts.anchor: the old Arthur comes back – for an hour, for a day

facts.fact: 电线里第二个声音是那个没有来过圣诞节的儿子
facts.anchor: the one who had not come for Christmas
